description: SAP Enterprise Monitoring Dashboard - All T-Codes
title: SAP Enterprise Monitoring

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lock_count),0) as value FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status = 'Running'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status = 'Waiting'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM st22_dumps WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', NOW()) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT ROUND(100 - cpu_idle, 2) as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * memory_used_bytes / NULLIF(memory_total_bytes, 0), 2) as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

WITH metrics AS (SELECT (100-cpu_idle) as cpu_pct, (100.0*memory_used_bytes/NULLIF(memory_total_bytes,0)) as mem_pct, disk_utilization FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ROUND(100 - GREATEST(COALESCE(cpu_pct,0)/10, COALESCE(mem_pct,0)/10, COALESCE(disk_utilization,0)/10), 0) as value FROM metrics
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) as value FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client) as value FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transaction) as value FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) as value FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT client, COUNT(*) as sessions FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY client ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT transaction, COUNT(*) as count FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY transaction ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT terminal, COUNT(*) as sessions FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY terminal ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, COUNT(*) as active_sessions FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT client as "Client", user_name as "User", transaction as "Transaction", terminal as "Terminal", login_time as "Login Time", host as "Host" FROM al08_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lock_count),0) as value FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) as value FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) as value FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT user_name, SUM(lock_count) as locks FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY locks DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT table_name, SUM(lock_count) as locks FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY locks DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, SUM(lock_count) as total_locks FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT table_name as "Table", lock_object as "Lock Object", user_name as "User", client as "Client", lock_mode as "Lock Mode" FROM sm12_locks WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status = 'Running'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status = 'Waiting'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_type = 'DIA'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_type = 'BGD'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_type = 'UPD'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_type = 'SPO'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status = 'Stopped'
SELECT wp_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY wp_status
SELECT wp_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY wp_type
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(cpu_time) as avg_cpu FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' AND wp_status='Running' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT user_name, SUM(cpu_time) as total_cpu FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY total_cpu DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT wp_number as "WP#", wp_type as "Type", wp_status as "Status", ROUND(cpu_time,2) as "CPU (s)", user_name as "User", program as "Program", client as "Client", report as "Report" FROM sm50_workprocesses WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant = '${tenant}' ORDER BY cpu_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500
SELECT ROUND(100 - cpu_idle, 2) as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant='${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0*memory_used_bytes/NULLIF(memory_total_bytes,0),2) as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant='${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT disk_utilization as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant='${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0*swap_used_bytes/NULLIF(swap_total_bytes,0),2) as value FROM st06_system_perf WHERE tenant='${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(100-cpu_idle) as "CPU Total", AVG(cpu_user) as "User", AVG(cpu_system) as "System", AVG(cpu_wait) as "I/O Wait" FROM st06_system_perf WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(memory_used_bytes)/1073741824 as "Used (GB)", AVG(memory_free_bytes)/1073741824 as "Free (GB)" FROM st06_system_perf WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(disk_utilization) as "Utilization %" FROM st06_system_perf WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(network_in_bytes)/1024 as "In (KB/s)", AVG(network_out_bytes)/1024 as "Out (KB/s)" FROM st06_system_perf WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', time) as time, AVG(page_in_rate) as "Page In", AVG(page_out_rate) as "Page Out" FROM st06_system_perf WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM st22_dumps WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', NOW()) AND tenant='${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM st22_dumps WHERE time >= date_trunc('day', NOW()) AND tenant='${tenant}' AND is_critical=TRUE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT program) as value FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) as value FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}'
SELECT dump_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY dump_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT program, COUNT(*) as dumps FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY program ORDER BY dumps DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT user_name, COUNT(*) as dumps FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY user_name ORDER BY dumps DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) as time, COUNT(*) as "Total Dumps", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_critical) as "Critical" FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time as "Date/Time", client as "Client", user_name as "User", program as "Program", dump_type as "Dump Type", host as "Host", line_number as "Line#", is_critical as "Critical" FROM st22_dumps WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND tenant='${tenant}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 500
